description: This file defines the TeleSuiteUpdater class, which manages test suite updates, reporting, and error handling within a testing framework. It includes methods for processing test reports, configuring reporters, and maintaining test state.

classes.name: TeleSuiteUpdater
classes.description: Manages test suite updates, report processing, and error handling for a testing framework.

methods.name: _createReporter
methods.description: Creates a ReporterV2 object with event handlers for test configuration, execution, and errors.

methods.name: processGlobalReport
methods.description: Processes a global report by dispatching messages to a new TeleReporterReceiver.

methods.name: processListReport
methods.description: Processes a list report, saves current test results, and resets the receiver.

methods.name: processTestReportEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a test report event to the last run receiver and main receiver.

methods.name: _handleOnError
methods.description: Handles test errors by updating error list and invoking error callbacks.

methods.name: asModel
methods.description: Returns the current state of the test suite updater as a model object.
